# Reflex 1.3.1
## Codex Micro startup repair
- Fixes the deterministic launch crash when a Codex Micro is already connected. - Registers the passive raw-report callback once at the HID manager level before activation, as required by IOKit. - Keeps reconnect, pause, shutdown, mappings, lighting, and device firmware behavior unchanged.

# Reflex 1.3.0
## Codex Micro controls
- F13 now foregrounds Codex or starts a new task when Codex is already active; F15 foregrounds Slack; F14 foregrounds the default browser. - The dial moves through adjacent Slack conversations and Chrome tabs, and scrolls the focused Codex conversation when Codex is foregrounded. - The upper directional control moves backward and forward through Slack or Chrome history. - Repeated same-direction dial turns now arrive through the raw passive HID report stream without dropped detents or duplicate handling. - A local, nonactivating Input Diagnostics panel makes device behavior inspectable without collecting anything while it is closed.

# Reflex 1.2.1
## Codex Micro word deletion
- The Codex Micro key above Return now sends Option-Delete, deleting the previous word instead of one character.

# Reflex 1.2.0
## Simpler input, sharper shortcuts
- Removes the Evoluent remapper and all exclusive mouse capture. Reflex now leaves pointer and scroll handling entirely to macOS. - Adds a Codex Micro Backspace shortcut to the key directly above Return. - Requires a quicker, more deliberate mouse shake to reveal clipboard history. - Option-Command-C copies once without applying Reflex clipboard rewrites. - Includes the saved Codex Micro Wispr Flow, Return, Codex, and browser mappings.

# Reflex 1.1.2
## Wireless mouse recovery
- Mouse Remapping now stays enabled when the Evoluent disconnects during a battery change. - Remapping resumes automatically after the mouse reconnects and native pointer delivery is verified. - Reflex remains safely passive if macOS has not restored native mouse handling. - Sleep, wake, and login-session transitions no longer change the user's Mouse Remapping setting.

# Reflex 1.1.1
## Update status
- Successful update checks now show the time they completed. - The last successful check remains visible after restarting Reflex. - A successful “no update available” result no longer appears as a failed check.

# Reflex 1.1.0
## Automatic updates
- Reflex now checks quietly for signed updates once a day. - Use **Check for Updates…** from the right-click menu whenever you want to check immediately. - A subtle dot on the menu-bar icon lets you know when an update is ready.
## Mouse responsiveness
- Reduced Reflex processing overhead by 98% for pointer movement, 97% for scrolling, and 78% for clicks. - Preserved raw HID event ordering so quick button-down and button-up events cannot be reordered.
